mentions.name: Polished Deej-style hardware volume mixer
mentions.description: A hardware volume mixer, similar to Deej but more polished, featuring app drag-and-drop for assignment, programmable macro buttons, and small OLED displays that show app icons and volume levels. Built entirely in Rust, including the MCU firmware.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on creating a volume mixer, basically like Deej, but more polished.

evidence.value: I'm working on creating a volume mixer, basically like Deej, but more polished.
